value.rationale: Fixed oblique discontinuity interfaces are a canonical mismatch for axis-aligned stratified Monte Carlo. The theorem gives all primitive integer directions, all finite grid sizes, and an exact sharp nonconvergent leading risk constant; already slope (1,1) has variance constants throughout [7c/32,c/4] for irrational c, a 12.5% swing relative to the upper value. This makes phase-independent sharp asymptotics false and informs reproducible grid-error assessment; no arbitrary unmotivated finite slice or routine bound is claimed.
